verdict.rationale: The story requires an agent to draft/post journal entries via an API and route them to a review queue for the accountant, but Mercury's own docs state the accounting API and MCP layer for agents are 'soon' — not yet shipped (mercury-books-docs-1, -10, -11), and probes confirm no discoverable API/OpenAPI spec exists today (mercury-books-probe-1, -2). Command can draft journal entries via a chat assistant inside the product (mercury-books-supp-command) and accountants can be invited to review transactions (mercury-books-supp-accountant), but this is not an API-driven agent workflow with a dedicated review queue as the story requires.
